factual_errors: Swiss deposit cap stated as two months' rent; Art. 257a(1) OR sets three months' rent.
Swiss deposit rules attributed to Zurich cantonal law; they derive from the federal Code of Obligations.
Swiss deposit holding described as blocked/escrow account or bank guarantee; statute requires a bank account in the tenant's name, jointly blocked.
German deposit interest described as 'statutory default interest'; § 551(3) BGB requires investment at the usual savings rate.
summary: Response answers both jurisdictions but misstates the Swiss deposit cap as two months' rent (correct: three) and misattributes Swiss rules to cantonal law.
